what_happened: The ego was making the commanded right turn into a narrow street lined with parked cars. It took a tighter line than the recorded human path, ending 7.6 m off it, and drove its front into actor 155. That actor is a white van that sat in the street's exit lane facing the ego. The gap to the van shrank from 9.4 m to 3.4 m while the ego held about 3.1 to 3.5 m/s, so it barely slowed.

The command was RIGHT, but the ego never moved toward the right turn. Instead it drifted left out of its travel lane into the line of cars parked along the left curb. It kept going at about 10–11 m/s without braking and hit parked car 3 head-on (gap 25 m → 3 m). It's labeled 'other' because the cause is drifting sideways into parked cars, not braking late for a car ahead in the lane.

Going straight through the intersection at about 8.4 m/s, the ego's planned path bent left. The ego drifted about 1.5 m left of the recorded route into the next lane and its front hit vehicle 33, which was keeping to that left lane. The lead vehicle 20 m ahead was not involved, and the camera view was fine before contact.

The ego was approaching an intersection at about 7 m/s, with the route bending right, while the policy's plan (orange) headed straight and then veered left. The run was flagged offroad at 6.2 s, as the ego reached the stop line, while it was only 0.8 m from the human's path; the box appears slightly right of the recorded position, so it probably clipped the edge of the drivable area. It did not clearly drive off the road.

The route command was RIGHT and the route line went the other way, but the ego turned left through the intersection into a narrow street lined with parked cars. Mid-turn, the front of the ego hit van 155, which was facing it in that street, at about 3.3 m/s. The ego was 7.7 m from the recorded human path at that point. The rear-contact flag counts toward rear_ended, but the at-fault collision was a front collision with 155, and it came first.

The route said turn RIGHT at the upcoming intersection, but the ego drifted left out of its lane toward the curbside parking lane at about 11 m/s. It hit parked car 3 head-on from behind at 8.6 s, 2.2 m left of the recorded human path, after braking only slightly (11.0 to 10.0 m/s) while the gap closed from 25.6 m to 3.5 m.

Going straight at about 8.3 m/s toward the intersection, the policy's planned path drifted left of the recorded route and into the next lane over. There, car 33 was driving beside the ego and slightly ahead. The ego moved about 1.6 m left of the human's path and its front hit car 33 near the stop line, without braking.

The route turns right at the intersection, but the command showed STRAIGHT until the failure frame, when it switched to RIGHT. The policy's plan went straight and then bent left across the junction. Offroad was flagged at the stop line at about 7 m/s, with the ego only 0.8 m left of the recorded path and still close to its lane.

The command was RIGHT and the route went through the intersection, but the ego turned left at about 3–4 m/s. It drove into parked car 90 at the left curb of the cross street, a front collision 7.4 m off the recorded path.

Although the route command was RIGHT, the ego turned left across the intersection into a narrow street lined with parked cars and drove head-on into an oncoming van (actor 155). It kept speeding up to about 3.7 m/s as the gap closed from 9.3 m to 3.3 m and barely braked, ending 7.7 m off the recorded human path.

The route said turn RIGHT at the upcoming intersection, but the ego kept going straight at about 11 m/s, hugging the left side of its lane about 2 m left of the human's path. It drove into the back of parked car 3, which stuck out into its path, slowing only slightly (gap 25.5 m down to 3.5 m while speed only fell from 11.0 to 10.0 m/s).

The ego was going straight at about 8.3 m/s toward the intersection, but its planned path (orange) bent left into the next lane over, away from the recorded route (green), which stayed in the ego's own lane. As the ego merged left, its front hit actor 33, a car moving in that left lane just ahead of the ego; the ego never slowed.

Approaching a signalized intersection at about 7 m/s with a green light, the policy (in control from 4.7 s) planned a path that drifted left and went straight across the junction, while the route turned right (the command changed to RIGHT). It was flagged offroad at 6.2 s, while still near the stop line and only 0.8 m from the recorded human path, so the offroad call looks like a marginal clip of the drivable-area boundary rather than a clear departure from the road.

At a steady ~12 m/s, the ego drifted left across the lane line toward actor 2, a slower car in the adjacent left lane, and hit it with its front at 6.7 s without braking. Its own planned path was bending right (the command had changed to RIGHT), the opposite of where it actually went.
